sentences.text:
Opposite Party
 Mr.S.S.Pradhan, Aga
 Ms. Bini Mishra, Advocate
 (for informant)

1. This application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed in connection with Mangalabag P.S.
Case No.114 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No.334 of 2023, pending in the file of the learned J.M.F.C., Cuttack under Sections 419, 420, 403, 120 (B), 34 of IPC.
2.
Mr. Ratikanta Mohapatra, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the informant has alleged that she was cheated of 62 lakhs but this is not supported by documents or bank statement.

He further submits that in order to show his bona fides, the petitioner is willing to return an amount of Rs.11,00,000/- to the informant.
3.
Mr.S.S.Pradhan, learned Addl. Government Advocate submits that the copy of the bail application has not been served on him.

4. In view of the submission of learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is prepared to refund the amount of Rs.11,00,000/- to the informant, it is not necessary to direct the learned counsel for State to obtain instructions or direct counsel for the petitioner to serve a copy of the bail application on him.
5. The petitioner will be at liberty to file a fresh application for bail after returning the amount of Rs.11,00,000/- to the informant.
